rules.requirement: All seven admin-order obligations are contract-only. No controller or resolved permission exists; never use guest/customer routes or checkout tokens as an admin workaround.

Payment reconcile requires Step-Up and payment.reconcile idempotency. Provider lease is two minutes; amount mismatch/reference conflict needs manual review. No manual mark-paid action. Payment list default50/max200; attempts are read-only.

Create requires eligible settled payment, positive integer Toman and reason_code. Cap is checked at create/process. Creator cannot approve own refund. Retry only failed; reconcile processing/unknown; cancel requested/approved/failed only. All refund mutations require Step-Up and scoped idempotency; provider support is not guaranteed.

Confirmed settled order and reservation required. Allocate single_warehouse_preferred/manual with unique positive item/warehouse quantities. Start preparation requires full allocation. Pick delta cannot exceed allocation; unpick cannot undercut shipped quantity and requires reason. No uniform warehouse scope guarantee is inferred.

Create requires confirmed settled order, warehouse, shipping method and unique positive picked items. Draft->ready->handed_over; cancel draft/ready only. Handover and cancel require Step-Up. Tracking refresh requires provider and tracking number; no manual delivery or tracking-number edit route.

Create validates lowercase code, Persian name and nonnegative integer Toman fee; active defaults true. PATCH If-Match permits name/fee/active, not code. No delete, Step-Up or idempotency decorator is invented.

Requested->under_review->approved; receive approved/in_transit_to_store requires all items positive after receipt; inspect received; resolve inspecting only with exact unique item coverage and resolution_note. Refund positive integer amount capped by delivered line value, non-refund amount forbidden; stock dispositions require warehouse. Reject needs reason. Resolve requires Step-Up.

Requested->under_review->approved->received->repairing; resolve received/repairing, close resolved only. Refund/replacement needs positive quantity within delivered quantity; refund positive integer Toman capped by line value, non-refund amount forbidden. Resolve and close require Step-Up; both require resolution_note. Refund/replacement references are requests.
Frozen shift/store/register operations have unresolved assembled-contract/runtime evidence. Preserve all seven NO_ACTION dispositions and do not infer an executable shift lifecycle.

Frozen POS sale operations remain NO_ACTION even where controller exists outside assembled OpenAPI. Runtime commit expected_version is a body field, not If-Match. Cash/card source evidence does not authorize any action.

All six offline/reconciliation obligations remain NO_ACTION. Runtime retry only failed and recovery_count<5, requires owner sync; retry is not completed sale. Abandon failed only. Preserve staff ownership, no owner transfer or automatic sync is invented.

focus.entry: Focus heading; logical RTL order and LTR-isolated identifiers and references; no data disclosure outside permission.
focus.dialog: Initial focus safe cancel; Tab trapped in modal, Escape restores trigger. Step-Up inherits secure B behavior and returns to review.
focus.error: After failed submit focus linked error summary and inline description; retain safe input; asynchronous refresh never steals focus.
focus.navigation: Keyboard alternatives for every action, labelled compact cards and44px minimum touch targets; no fixed action obscures focus. Polite result announcement.

screens.permissionBoundary: Per-operation permissions are conjunctive; surface permission union is discovery metadata, never an all-or-any authorization rule. Unknown is denied.
screens.behavior: Create requires eligible settled payment, positive integer Toman and reason_code. Cap is checked at create/process. Creator cannot approve own refund. Retry only failed; reconcile processing/unknown; cancel requested/approved/failed only. All refund mutations require Step-Up and scoped idempotency; provider support is not guaranteed. Server permission and lifecycle remain authoritative. Design evidence grants no permission and certifies no runtime readiness.
screens.readBoundary: Use only the traced authorized read response, local filters on loaded records and returned references. No invented total, cursor, audit endpoint, cross-domain permission or guest/customer workaround. Blocked operations expose no data and remain NO_ACTION.

screens.permissionBoundary: Per-operation permissions are conjunctive; surface permission union is discovery metadata, never an all-or-any authorization rule. Unknown is denied.
screens.behavior: Requested->under_review->approved; receive approved/in_transit_to_store requires all items positive after receipt; inspect received; resolve inspecting only with exact unique item coverage and resolution_note. Refund positive integer amount capped by delivered line value, non-refund amount forbidden; stock dispositions require warehouse. Reject needs reason. Resolve requires Step-Up. Server permission and lifecycle remain authoritative. Design evidence grants no permission and certifies no runtime readiness.
screens.readBoundary: Use only the traced authorized read response, local filters on loaded records and returned references. No invented total, cursor, audit endpoint, cross-domain permission or guest/customer workaround. Blocked operations expose no data and remain NO_ACTION.

focus.entry: Focus heading; logical RTL order and LTR-isolated identifiers and references; no data disclosure outside permission.
focus.dialog: Initial focus safe cancel; Tab trapped in modal, Escape restores trigger. Step-Up inherits secure B behavior and returns to review.
focus.error: After failed submit focus linked error summary and inline description; retain safe input; asynchronous refresh never steals focus.
focus.navigation: Keyboard alternatives for every action, labelled compact cards and44px minimum touch targets; no fixed action obscures focus. Polite result announcement.

screens.permissionBoundary: Per-operation permissions are conjunctive; surface permission union is discovery metadata, never an all-or-any authorization rule. Unknown is denied.
screens.behavior: Requested->under_review->approved->received->repairing; resolve received/repairing, close resolved only. Refund/replacement needs positive quantity within delivered quantity; refund positive integer Toman capped by line value, non-refund amount forbidden. Resolve and close require Step-Up; both require resolution_note. Refund/replacement references are requests. Server permission and lifecycle remain authoritative. Design evidence grants no permission and certifies no runtime readiness.
